svg.aria-label: Sixty-two day cells of nested semicircular arcs, one arc per sunlit hour, recorded at Fort Peck, Montana

g.text: Fort Peck, Montana · 634 m · sixty-one days, one sun each
Each arc is one hour of sunlight on level ground; its radius is that
hour’s strength. Points beneath the line are hours that gave none.
The faint outer ring is the brightest hour in the whole record.
